NEOW.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-2.ancient: [sine]...very well..... so. be. it... keep... your... ..secrets...[/sine]
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-0.ancie: Violent!! Scary! I don't like it!
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-1.char: Just hand me over your items.
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-2.ancie: [sine]Look these![/sine] Take all!! Just don't eat me!!
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-3.char:
[jitter]You anger me![/jitter]
I rarely stoop that low.
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.anci:
Violence... not the solution!!
Strike deals!
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-1r.char: [jitter]Don't tell me what's right and what isn't.[/jitter]
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-1.char: Violence is a part of me.
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-2.char:
The Architect... my next trophy.
Not to mention the riches I collect...
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-3.ancie: Architect good!! Talking better than hurting!!
OROBAS.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.anci:
You collect trophies...
But never friends!!!
PAEL.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-2.ancient:
[thinky_dots]No matter...
You may assimilate parts of me.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.ancien:
[thinky_dots]The masking one is back...
Leave quietly...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-1.ancient:
[thinky_dots]I'm not much different than you...
Just more decomposed.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-3.ancient:
[thinky_dots]It's a story for another day...
Time to sleep...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.ancien:
[thinky_dots]Everything falls apart eventually...
Even the monsters.[/thinky_dots]
TEZCATARA.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.a:
You and your... friends.. sure eat a lot.
[jitter][b]Dispose[/b][/jitter] of [red]him[/red] already, would you?
TEZCATARA.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-0.an: I know your goal. Eat up first!
TEZCATARA.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.a:
You burn with a fierce anger.
Have you ever tried letting it warm you instead?
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-0.ancient:
You seem scary!
Don't worry, I don't bite!
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-1.char:
Friendly? You?
You kiss your mom with that mouth of yours?
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-2.char: You even smell like a merchant.
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-3.ancient:
Aren't you a vulgar one!
Not that I mind!
Company is nice.
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.ancien:
My favorite friend!
Take a look at my wares!
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-0.char: Whoever you are, let's get this over with.
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-2.ancient: Slay the Architect and I will reward you even more!
DARV.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.ancien:
You know, for someone who scares everyone away...
You sure do visit often!
VAKUU.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-1.char: Well, I'm not interested in you.
VAKUU.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.ancie: Let me be your mind instead.
VAKUU.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-1.char: Get on with it, creep. Show me your schem-...deals... and nothing else this time.
VAKUU.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.ancie:
They fear you.
Hate you.
Only I understand you...
VAKUU.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-3r.char: Suddenly scared, huh? What a joke you are.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-0.an:
I'm so sorry for you...
What happened to that hand, that face of yours?
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.a:
Let me comfort you.
This emotion...
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-1r.c: What is it that you mean?
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-2r.a:
Oh, it's nothing.
I'm sorry to bother you... sweetie.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-0.an: I'm still grieving what happened to you...
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-1.an:
Let me hug you.
It's the very least I can do.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-2.ch:
This feels nice.
Warm.
Thank you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0.an: You hide behind anger so well...
NONUPEIPE.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.4-0r.a:
You came back!
...I was worried you had forgotten my embrace...
TANX.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-0r.ancien: HOW SHALL WE SPAR THIS TIME?
TANX.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-0.ancient:
YOUR NAME SAYS IT ALL!
FIGHT ME!!
TANX.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Brute dodges Tanx' pounce and deeply wounds his arm.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-2.ancient:
YOU COULD TAKE ME DOWN!!
HERE, A PRIZE!
TANX.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-0r.ancien:
YOUR WEAPON IS STILL AMAZING!!
YOUR ANGER TOO!!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.0-: Riches is the word. Getting spared is of your interest.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.1-: Takes one to know one, huh?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.2-: I see despair building up inside.
I hear them pray, such a waste of time.
Why would this time be different?
If every day is just the same...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.3-:
The foreword is mine.
The pleasure is not.

Look who learnt my ways of talking now...
Did all these parasites finally get to you?
[jitter]Now is not a good time. Get out.[/jitter]
Wallow in the pain. You deserve it.

I will strike you a deal.
I end your misery now, you point me to the riches.

[jitter]Whatever.
I will have them cure this disease.[/jitter]
